description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Zirda, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Soul Warden and Davvol trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Davvol trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
